# Cloudflare Worker + MCP boilerplate

> A TypeScript starter with a static Astro web app, a Cloudflare D1 database, and a Worker that serves the account API and an authenticated Model Context Protocol (MCP) endpoint.

## Development

- [Choose the owning module for a feature or place a new Astro page](/docs/architecture.md)
- [Change a D1 schema and generate a Drizzle migration](/docs/database.md)
- [Link an account, connect an MCP client, or add a tool operation](/docs/access-and-mcp.md)

## Deployment

- [Configure GitHub Actions to deploy the Worker and web assets](/docs/deployment.md)
- [Provision D1 and Cloudflare Access or configure Terraform state in R2](/docs/terraform.md)
- [Find an MCP client's OAuth callback or troubleshoot a rejected redirect](/docs/mcp-oauth-callbacks.md)
